subject: CoachHouse Cloud: coordinating marketplace technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@coachhousecloud.com>

Cc: Mohammed Rahman <mohammed.rahman@coachhousecloud.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CoachHouse Cloud — Redwood marketplace technical deep-dive

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier today — appreciate the quick overview of Redwood’s marketplace flow. CoachHouse is excited about a partner listing and we want to schedule a technical deep-dive so our engineering and marketplace teams can align on integration surface area and verify required artifacts.

High-level asks for the deep-dive:
- Walkthrough of the marketplace onboarding flow and required API/webhooks.
- Review of any runtime constraints for private/dedicated deployments (auth, telemetry, data residency).
- Clarify expected artifacts for the listing (logo, description, test account, support SLA).

Who from Redwood should present on the call (product vs. infra)? We have both our Marketplace PM and a solutions engineer available.

We’re flexible next week but prefer mornings PST. Proposed windows (all PST):
- Tue 18 Nov: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 19 Nov: 10:00–12:00

If you can share a short pre-read (integration checklist), that would help our engineers prepare. I’ve attached our infra profile so you can see our current environment.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Partnerships | CoachHouse Cloud
attachments: CoachHouse-infra-profile.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CoachHouse Cloud — Redwood marketplace technical deep-dive

Hi Aisha — great to meet earlier, and thanks for the infra profile. Camila (partner integrations) and Vivek (marketplace infra) are looped on this thread and will lead the deep-dive.

We can cover the checklist you mentioned. Attaching a short "Redwood Marketplace Overview" and a "tech intake" template that lists exact artifacts we ask partners to provide ahead of listing. Please populate the intake sheet where convenient.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 19 Nov: 09:30–10:30 (30–45 min + buffer)
- Thu 20 Nov: 11:00–12:00
- Fri 21 Nov: 08:30–09:30

Camila will run the product walk; Vivek will take the infra/API portion and cover auth + test accounts. If any of the windows above work, we’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Action items:
- Aisha: confirm preferred slot and attach populated intake sheet.
- CoachHouse: share a dev/test account (or sandbox credentials) read-only for pre-validation.
- Van/Redwood: document any required network egress IPs and provide the onboarding checklist in Drive.

Attachments: redwood-marketplace-overview.pdf, tech-intake-template.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — redwoodai.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@coachhousecloud.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CoachHouse Cloud — Redwood marketplace technical deep-dive

Adding a couple of quick technical notes so the call can be efficient —

1) Auth and scopes: we support OAuth 2.0 client credentials and short-lived API tokens for partner listing automation. Can you confirm whether CoachHouse prefers to manage tokens via your KMS or have Redwood issue scoped tokens for the listing test account?

2) Test account: read-only credentials with sample payloads (example alerts + request traces) are ideal. If you can share a workspace id and one sample request/response pair, we can validate offline before the call.

3) Network / egress: most partners don't need special whitelisting for hosted marketplace listings, but for private deployments we publish a small set of egress IP ranges. If you anticipate on-prem or VPC installs, flag that now so we surface the detailed IP/CIDR list in the pre-read.

4) SDKs & compatibility: if you have a preferred runtime for your sidecar (e.g., Python 3.10 or Java 17), call that out in the intake sheet. We’ll prepare an integration snippet.

If Camila/Vanessa confirm a slot, happy to prepare a short network/auth diagram and example curl flow to include in the calendar invite.

— Vivek
Principal Engineer, Marketplace Integrations | Redwood Inference
